title: A quick preview of our cozy tidy-up game, Back in the Box!  | Looking for a few players for round 3 of playtesting
author: EvilBlowFish
selftext:
Hi everyone! We're a two-person team making a cozy, low-stress game in our spare time. It's all about tidying up board games: you pack away the pieces, sort everything neatly into the inserts and containers, and put the games back on the shelf.

We're having a great time making **Back in the Box**! Our Steam page is coming very soon, and we're looking for a few playtesters.

All of the game's code and mechanics were written with Claude Code. At first all of the art was AI too: the AI drew the 3D props in code, and we made 2D images like the box lids and cards with Google Gemini. Since then we've been swapping a lot of it out. Most 3D props are now Blender models made from scripts or free CC0/CC-BY models from Poly Haven, Sketchfab and Fab. The box lid art and some card art are still Gemini, and we'll disclose that on Steam. None of the sound is AI. Many effects are our own recordings of real pieces, made with an iPhone or a Blue Yeti.

We've mostly used Opus 5.5, with Sonnet 5.5 for a good share of the bug fixes and smaller changes. It's been a really fun and educational process!
